responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first baseline (360px-430px) with responsive scaling up to lg (1024px) and xl (1280px). Always style mobile layouts first without prefix, then apply sm:, md:, lg: overlays.
responsive.layout: Single-column stacked structure on mobile devices (flex-col, grid-cols-1) transitioning to asymmetric Bento/Tetris grid layouts on lg screens. Navigation collapses gracefully into a sleek bottom sheet or frosted blur drawer on mobile.
responsive.typography: Fluid text hierarchy using rem units. Main H1 strictly capped at text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl (never text-7xl or text-8xl). Body text text-sm sm:text-base. Form inputs text-base (16px) to avoid iOS Safari automatic zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root element and top containers. All text strings and code addresses (e.g., wallet hashes) wrapped with truncate or break-all to prevent unwanted horizontal page scroll.
responsive.tap_targets: All interactive elements (quiz options, referral copy buttons, task checkboxes, navigation tabs, filter buttons) must have minimum touch area of 44x44px with comfortable padding.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
scale.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-cyan-400

visual_enhancers.grid_lines: Background subtle cyan grid overlay using repeating linear gradients (opacity 0.04)
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)] for active cards and WL pass indicators
visual_enhancers.cyber_decorations: Terminal angle cut corners, corner crosshairs (+), scanning line animations, HUD-style metric badges
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise grain overlay and dark skeletal anatomical silhouette backgrounds

component_structure.header: Sticky navbar with blur background (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#07080c]/80), Osteon Cyber-Bone logo, '206 BONES' status ticker, navigation tabs, and Wallet Identity status badge.
component_structure.hero: Asymmetric hero with glowing cyber-skeleton 3D canvas effect, 206 NFT collection tagline, live whitelist stats, and direct CTA to start Qualification Test.
component_structure.lore_concept_bento: 4-card Bento grid detailing Axial vs Appendicular skeletal distribution, 206 Cybernetic NFT trait system, anatomical rarity, and whitelist utility.
component_structure.task_section: Twitter integration tasks card (Follow, Retweet, Like self-declared checkboxes) with verification badge status indicators.
component_structure.qualification_test: Interactive 100-point test module: 10 MCQ quiz questions (5 pts each) + 5 guess-the-bone image MCQs (10 pts each). Includes score meter, question stepper, countdown timer, and pass/fail whitelist screen (70+ score threshold).
component_structure.referral_card: Unique link generator (`osteon.xyz/wl?ref=...`), 1-click copy, Twitter share trigger, live referral counter, and 'Unlock Extra Test Attempt' mechanism.
component_structure.leaderboard: Cyberpunk leaderboard table displaying top referrers, test scores, wallet address truncation, whitelist qualification badge, and search filter.
component_structure.admin_panel: Passcode/ENV protected drawer/modal to inspect all registered users, edit/add quiz questions, adjust test cooldowns, and export participant data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app is built as a single cohesive responsive Web3 dApp with seamless tab/scroll navigation and dynamic persistent state in React.
Implement local storage state management for user identity (wallet address + twitter handle), quiz attempts, cooldown timestamps, referrals count, and leaderboard submissions.
Include pre-loaded rich dataset of 10 multiple choice anatomical Web3 questions (5 pts each) and 5 guess-the-bone visual image questions (10 pts each) with crisp anatomical diagram graphics.

Ensure all buttons, form inputs, links, and key status badges include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='wallet-connect-btn', data-testid='quiz-option-0', data-testid='referral-copy-btn').
Follow mobile-first design principles strictly: layout must render cleanly on mobile viewports (360px+) without horizontal scrollbar.
Do NOT use pure black background or default light blue gradients. Use deep dark void (#07080c) with neon cyber cyan (#00f0ff) and skeletal emerald (#00ff66) highlights.
Integrate sonner toast notifications for actions like wallet link, task completion, test result submission, and referral copy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
